text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! I've done it! Yaaaaay!

Her voice, strong and impassioned,
echoes
throughout Nakayama.

Meisho Doto surpasses her formidable
peers at
last, standing as a shining
beacon on the highest
peak!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Impossible! The Overlord, in my most
perfect
form, has been unmistakably
bested...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, nothing is more satisfying than
having
met defeat under these
circumstances! It is, in
fact, a miracle—a
master class in dramatic twists!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes... yes, yes, yeees! Trainer, I really
did it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm strong, and I shine bright! The
unconfident me
is nowhere to be seen!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Waaaaah!
choice_data_list: Don't cry. You're a strong girl, aren't you?
Don't cry. You're a strong girl, right?

text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try to console her,
Meisho
Doto's emotions keep flaring up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was a bit unexpected, Grass. I
was so
focused on Opera O the entire
time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That was a splendid display of
force.
However...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It only reveals our own immaturity.
Through all
the agony of her repeated
mistakes...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She remained, never giving up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
While the headliner was bathed in the
people's
spotlight, a hidden talent stood
lurking in her
shadow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
By most, she was either ignored or
looked down
upon. Except...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There was one person who recognized
her talents.
And that someone poured in
the time and
attention she would need
to blossom into a flower
far bigger than
the rest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We would be mistaken to think our
defeat today
was a fluke—doing so
would result in only
repeated failures.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The evening primrose, grounded by
firmly cast
roots, grows so stunningly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This year, the strongest racer, towering
above us
all, is, without question, none
other than Meisho
Doto.
Later, at the awards ceremony...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-h-hello, everyone. I'm Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today, I ran, I cried, and I said a lot of
confusing
things to my trainer. I don't
remember it all
clearly, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy that I won. And, um... I have a
few
words to say, if that's okay with
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've never had much confidence in
myself.
Everything I did never seemed to
work out...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But the more races I participated in, the
more I
came to like myself...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I still don't feel very confident, even
with today's
results. That, I think, will
take a little while.

To feel confident... The first goal Doto
set for
herself is still a long way away.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I say this to say, I'm truly glad I started
racing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm clumsy, hopeless, and don't even
know when
to give up. I don't have a
way with words, either.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But, allow me to say this at the very
least!
Meisho Doto takes in a deep breath...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're at the bottom! Even if you
don't
like yourself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't have the
teeny-weeniest bit of
confidence!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: There is still hoooope!

She lets out a tempestuous roar while
fighting
back tears.

And so, the Umamusume who sought
hope at rock
bottom has emerged
triumphant, becoming a
beacon of hope
for many.
